warnings: Spread footings of foundation scheme 1 (ฐานรากแบบที่ 1) — joined to the S-01 plan only; the pile scheme's F1/F2 (S-09) are different members with the same marks.

main_bar.count is the two-way total (section 6b): 'เสริม 2 ทาง ๆละ n' = n each way. The column stub in the section is C1/C2 ตอม่อ (S-11). Depth from ระดับดินเดิม to the footing is printed only as 'ตามผลการทดสอบดิน' (per the soil test), so no level is recorded.
Edge tie 'เหล็กรัดรอบ DB12mm' prints no count — stirrup carries dia/type only (no invented count or spacing).
